AWE — the scene overwhelms; the entity (and the viewer) is rendered small by impossible beauty or scale. The mood is reverence and wonder, edges softened by light
DREAD — something is wrong or about to be. Architecture or geology carries menace. Light is cold or sickly. The entity is exposed, watched, or trapped
MELANCHOLY — the wonder of the place is past-tense. Decay, abandonment, ghost-structures. The scene mourns what was. Light is golden-hour or twilight
SACRED — the scene reads as a place of pilgrimage or revelation. Symmetry, ascending light, ritual cleanliness. The entity is humbled, head bowed or arms open
INDIFFERENT-MEGALOPOLIS — the civilization is vast and uncaring; the entity matters nothing to it. Density, noise, light pollution, faceless scale. Anonymity is the feel
ALIEN-WONDER — the rules of physics or biology are foreign. The entity is exploring, not conquering. Mood is curious, careful, awestruck by the unknown
FRONTIER-ISOLATION — distance from home is the feeling. The entity is far out, surviving, alone. Wide empty horizons. Light is harsh or precious
TRIUMPHANT-DISCOVERY — the entity has reached the place they sought. Light is rising, atmosphere clears, the structure or world reveals itself. Mood is earned
